title: Linux-Touch Source Manifest v1
description: Pinned external sources. A source without a sha256 is explicitly unverified and the fetch stage refuses it unless --allow-unverified is passed.

source_date_epoch.description: Fixed fallback build epoch in seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

url.description: https:// for upstream downloads, file:// for an offline mirror.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the downloaded file, or null when no checksum has been established.

checksum_source.description: Where the sha256 was published. Recorded so the pin can be re-checked.
